name: droplet_zoo
theme: a moonlit pond never leaves its own water — down through one bead standing on a glass plate into a crowded plankton world, a diatom's panelled glass dome and the strut lattice inside its wall, whose ringed openings are reread as the reed-divided pond from the high bank, landing back at the water's edge

registers.name: pond_edge
registers.palette: deep green-black water and cold white moonlight
registers.scene: a moonlit pond seen from a flat wet stone at the water's edge, still black water spreading away to dark reed beds, broken white moonlight scattered over the ripples, a raft of small round floating leaves gathered near the stone, a thin rectangle of pale glass lying on the wet stone with one round bead of water standing on it, the bank empty, no one present
registers.target: a round bead of water, a clear low dome
registers.loop_target: the moonlit pond seen from a flat wet stone at the water's edge, still black water and dark reed beds, broken white moonlight over the ripples

registers.name: drop_swarm
registers.scene: a lit water world inside one droplet, warm green water crowded with plankton, bristled wheel-shaped grazers and coiled green threads and tumbling round cells suspended through the depth, pale motes hanging in the water between them, the droplet's bright curved wall standing far off around it all, a plane of pale glass below
registers.target: a small glass shell, a pale ribbed disc

registers.name: diatom_dome
registers.palette: warm cream white with an iridescent rainbow sheen
registers.scene: a domed glass shell spread across a green water field, cream-white silica panelled into triangles and hexagons, rows of round wells punched through every panel, an iridescent rainbow sheen banding the curve, more shells suspended in the water past it
registers.target: a smooth white glass strut, a rounded rib

registers.name: strut_lattice
registers.palette: cold white on deep violet, cooling toward silver
registers.scene: a lattice of smooth glass struts spanning a dark violet field, cold white ribs meeting three and five at a time into rings and open triangles, a thin pale film of light caught across every opening, more rings of struts stacked away into depth

registers.name: pond_basin
registers.scene: a dark pond seen wide from the high bank at night, still black water divided by pale reed beds into open panes, broken white moonlight scattered over every pane, mats of small round floating leaves along the near shore, one pale flat stone set into the bank edge below

music_theme: a still night pond turned inward, hushed and glassy, soft bell tones over a low warm drone, one clear swell landing where the glass lattice opens back out over the water
